identify the initial structural configuration of the assembly
apply the thermodynamic threshold to the assembly structure
select the components possessing binding energy above the threshold
maintain the core position for these strongly held units
rejoin the selected core with the potential filtrate for balance check
initiate a reverse wash to carry away the weak associates
re-probe the refined assembly for any remaining loose units
identify the units with sub-threshold binding energy
transport the identified weak units to the external waste port
close the mass balance for the second purification cycle
transition from the stripping phase to the verification phase

write the final purified mass and filtrate volume to the permanent record
seal the analytical chamber with the purified remainder preserved
